This unit compiles Section 6.01(b) clauses (4) through (33) of a Limitation on Incurrence of Indebtedness covenant, plus the closing satisfy-and-discharge paragraph and the general compliance/interpretive rules (classification, outstanding-amount determination, PIK/accrual non-incurrence, ratio/EBITDA refinancing grandfathering, FX dollar-equivalent calculation, FX fluctuation carve-out, FX refinancing currency conversion, and the truncated no-subordination-characterization clause).

Several baskets (12b, 18(i), 19, 27) share their fixed-dollar/EBITDA-percentage aggregate ceiling with Refinancing Indebtedness incurred under Section 6.01(b)(13) to refinance debt originally incurred under that basket; these are modeled as WireSharedCapacity nodes with r13 as a co-member (r13's membership is limited to the subset of its usage attributable to refinancing that specific basket's originally-incurred debt).

Clause (14) was decomposed into three independently operative sub-rules matching its real alternative structure: (a)-(c) a ratio-gated unlimited basket (AND of three OR-tested ratio conditions), (d) an unlimited basket for qualifying Acquired Indebtedness, and (e) a capped fallback basket usable only to the extent (a)-(d) are unavailable.

Clause (13) (general Refinancing Indebtedness) has a transaction-relative capacity (bounded by the amount of the specific debt being refinanced plus permitted costs) that cannot be reduced to a fixed IR value; its substantive conditions (WAL test, subordination/type matching, exclusions) are otherwise fully captured.

'Available Amount' (basket (32)) is confirmed, via a dedicated definition lookup, to not be a defined term anywhere in this instrument's documents; 'Incremental Cap' (underlying basket (33)) resolves to a sum of four components, three of which (Voluntary Prepayment Incremental Amount, Ratio Incremental Amount, Extension Amount) were not resolvable from the evidence provided.

Numerous cross-references to Sections 6.08(a)(3)(b)/(3)(c), 6.08(b), and 6.08(b)(4) were out of scope per Phase 2's bounded retrieval; these are preserved as explicit dependsOn edges rather than silently dropped or guessed.
